title: Grouping Objects by Field with `Collectors.groupingBy` — Single, Multi-level, Downstream
question: How do you group objects by a field using Java Streams? Cover single-field, multi-level, and downstream collectors (counting, summing, mapping).

title: List to Map in Java Streams — `Collectors.toMap`, Duplicates, and Map Suppliers
question: How do you convert a List to a Map in Java Streams? Cover duplicate-key handling, ordered maps (LinkedHashMap supplier), and choosing between `toMap` and `groupingBy`.

title: Flattening Nested Collections with `flatMap` — The Idiomatic Java Stream Pattern
question: How do you flatten a list of lists using Java Streams? Cover `flatMap`, primitive variants, and common pitfalls.

title: Parallel vs Sequential Streams — When to Reach for `parallelStream`
question: When should you use parallel vs sequential streams in Java? Cover decision criteria: data size, per-element cost, splittability, side effects, pool contention.
